title: Stream chunks split inside UTF-8 characters
summary: The same bytes as stream.utf8 are split into chunks whose boundaries fall inside multi-byte characters.

messages.content: Reply exactly with: Café Zürich — καλημέρα! 東京で会いましょう 🌸🎉

requirements.text: The streamed text is reported exactly as the provider sent it.
The reported text contains no replacement characters.

grading_notes: The replay server pauses between chunks so clients see separate reads, though the operating system can still combine them. A correct client preserves the text regardless of where reads end. Decoding each chunk independently can introduce replacement characters. stream.utf8 is the unsplit control.
